proofBoundary: support matrix only; not real-model-runtime proof; not package-consumer-runtime proof; not post-publish proof
assetRequirements: model ONNX path and source URL
labels path, license, class count, and SHA256
input image or preprocessed tensor source/license/SHA256
YoloVision runner log and sample-run-evidence record before any real-model-runtime promotion

entries.modelSourceHint: Use the model owner's YOLOv5 export path; record repository, checkpoint, export command, opset, and license.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Prefer static or profile-compatible NCHW exports; document whether output is channel-first or box-first.
entries.postprocessNotes: Detection uses score filtering plus NMS; segmentation requires mask coefficients and prototype tensor metadata.

entries.modelSourceHint: Use the official or owner-approved YOLOv6 export path and record license/hash evidence.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Record input shape, class count, and any graph-side NMS.
entries.postprocessNotes: Use detection layout metadata; do not assume objectness semantics without owner-provided output description.

entries.modelSourceHint: Use owner-approved YOLOv7/pose assets and record source URL plus license.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Record output layout and keypoint tensor shape when pose is used.
entries.postprocessNotes: Detection path is ready; pose path requires keypoint count, stride, and tensor role metadata.

entries.status: official YOLOv8n segmentation and pose source-tree real-model runtime; other tasks require owner assets
entries.modelSourceHint: Use the hash-pinned Ultralytics v8.3.0 manifests for the audited segmentation/pose cases, or document the exact package version, source, license, and export command for another model.
entries.onnxExportNotes: The audited pose export uses images [1,3,640,640] and one output0 [1,56,8400]. Record dynamic/static shape, task type, output names, and whether graph includes NMS.
entries.postprocessNotes: Official YOLOv8n-pose embeds 4 box + 1 person class + 17x3 keypoint channels in one tensor; use --aux-channel-start 5. Separate keypoint tensors remain supported. Other task-specific auxiliary contracts require exact metadata.

entries.modelSourceHint: Use owner-approved YOLOv9 export and keep model redistribution separate from the repository.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Record export branch, opset, output layout, class count, and graph-side postprocess.
entries.postprocessNotes: Treat as metadata-driven until real runner log and evidence record exist.

entries.status: official YOLOv10n source-tree real-model runtime; end-to-end decode ready
entries.modelSourceHint: Use the hash-pinned THU-MIG YOLOv10 v1.1 ONNX asset and AGPL-3.0 repository provenance in samples/assets/yolovision-yolov10-official-assets.json.
entries.onnxExportNotes: For the built-in end-to-end path, verify a batch-1 [1,N,6] output with x1,y1,x2,y2,score,classId columns and record the exact exporter/version. The official YOLOv10n v1.1 ONNX proof uses images [1,3,640,640] and output0 [1,300,6].
entries.postprocessNotes: Use --layout end2end for the six-column decoder. It converts xyxy to the internal box representation, validates score/class/coordinates, and never applies a second NMS pass. Other YOLOv10 output contracts remain metadata-driven and require separate evidence.

entries.modelSourceHint: Use owner-approved YOLOv11 export; record model release, license, and hashes.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Record task, class count, output tensor roles, and profile shapes.
entries.postprocessNotes: Use the same task metadata model as YOLOv8, but require real evidence before promotion.

entries.status: future-family-planning; blocked until owner assets and output metadata exist
entries.modelSourceHint: Treat as forward-compatible/custom family until a concrete owner-approved implementation and model source are supplied.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Require explicit tensor names, shapes, task, and output roles.
entries.postprocessNotes: Use custom metadata; never claim real runtime proof from matrix presence.

entries.status: official YOLOX-S source-tree real-model runtime; detection-only design boundary
entries.modelSourceHint: Use the hash-pinned YOLOX 0.1.1rc0 release asset and Apache-2.0 repository provenance in samples/assets/yolovision-yolox-official-assets.json.
entries.onnxExportNotes: The official static model uses images [1,3,640,640] and raw output [1,8400,85].
entries.postprocessNotes: Apply (xy + grid) * stride and exp(wh) * stride for strides 8/16/32 before objectness scoring and application-side NMS; non-detection tasks are unsupported.

entries.modelSourceHint: Owner supplies model, labels, input tensor, license, SHA256, and output metadata.
entries.onnxExportNotes: Use TensorRtExec or OnnxToEngine build-only report before sample runtime.
entries.postprocessNotes: Promotion requires YoloVision run log, sample-run-evidence record, and validator output.
